conf.description: Cisco NX-OS acl-logging / snmp-trap: no stock integration or pack parses ACLLOG, so this is a genuine Cribl-side reparse of the CISCO-SYSLOG-MIB clogHistMsgText body (per direct.elastic recommendation), dissecting BOTH the Nexus 5/6k long-form and 7/9k abbreviated ACLLOG label dialects into ECS. Direct topology note: adopt the trap only where SNMP is already the collection path; do not dual-source with logging-server syslog for the same ACL family (double counts flows).

conf.comment: cisco-nxos / acl-logging / snmp-trap. Upstream SNMP trap receiver decodes the PDU and forwards varbinds as JSON. clogHistMsgText carries the whole labelled ACLLOG tuple in one of two dialects (long 'Source IP:'/'Hit-count =' form on N5/6k, abbreviated 'Src IP:'/'ACL Name:'/'ACE Action:' form on N7/9k) -- the trap only re-transports the body, it does not structure it, so both dialects are dissected here. clogHistSeverity is the 1-8 MIB enum, offset by one from the Cisco 0-7 digit and still inverted vs ECS -- log.level is derived from the standard severity-name table. The 255-byte clogHistMsgText cap can clip the abbreviated dialect past ACL name/hit-count; flagged via cisco_nexus.log.snmp.truncated for analyst visibility.

functions.description: document the varbind source, the two-dialect reparse, and the truncation caveat
extract the JSON-encoded varbind object the upstream SNMP trap receiver forwards
map the straight 1:1 CISCO-SYSLOG-MIB varbinds onto their targets (event.original is reparsed further below)
dissect the Nexus 5000/6000 long-form ACLLOG dialect

conf.regex: /Src IP:\s*(?<src_ip>[^,]+),\s*Dst IP:\s*(?<dst_ip>[^,]+),\s*Src Port:\s*(?<src_port>[^,]+),\s*Dst Port:\s*(?<dst_port>[^,]+),\s*Src Intf:\s*(?<src_intf>[^,]+),\s*Protocol:\s*"(?<proto_name>[A-Za-z0-9]+)"\((?<proto_num>\d+)\),\s*ACL Name:\s*(?<acl_name>[^,]+),\s*ACE Action:\s*(?<ace_action>[^,]+),\s*Appl Intf:\s*(?<appl_intf>[^,]+),\s*Hit-count:\s*(?<hit_count>\d+)/

functions.description: dissect the Nexus 7000/9000 abbreviated/detailed ACLLOG dialect

per direct.elastic: split protocol/ports/interface/ACL name/action/hit-count out of the dialect match, suppress the literal zero port, recover the Cisco severity digit and its inverted-scale log.level, route the two remaining unmapped varbinds to custom targets, and drop the now-redundant temp fields
tag the event with its dataset
